notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 68 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/7e93LMhFDUbZZX5SKYzXf0?si=cec8c26785114ffb) with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for minor add clear in end-game activities. Buzzard is a sidearm so it's likely to be less than optimal for end-game content, as you have to be very close to use one. It's got good stats overall, but the subfamily is all quite compressed. We can get pretty much every stat close to 100 with this particular roll, except for range so max that out with Full Bore in the barrel, a range Masterwork and any of the Combat Effect magazine perks. In the first trait column as the support perk, Encore wouldn't normally be under consideration, as it's mainly thought of as a PvP perk, but at four stacks it adds -5% accuracy cone growth for easier crits, 20 Range and 32 Stability. With Frenzy in the second trait slot as the signature perk procced, you end up with range of 86, stability of 89 or 99 (depending on the mag), and handling and reload speed at 100, as well as the useful 15% damage boost. Recommended MW: Range, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Adaptive(300) Kinetic Sidearm Primary Ammo. "I loved Buzzard for the few seasons we had it. Now that it can roll Adept mods I love it even more. In PvE you can roll Kinetic Tremors which will give Buzzard a bit more utility in higher-end content. Overflow is arguably one of my favorite perks in the game. Perpetual Motion also needs you to be mobile, easy with a sidearm as you have to get close. Compulsive Reloader is easy to use but falls off quickly with the low magazine size."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. Adaptive(300) Kinetic Sidearm Primary Ammo. "Buzzard with Rangefinder will have a 17m range, going all into range will only bump that up to 18m. I would highly recommend just investing your stats into making the gun feel better as your range will just not bump up the same way. You can max out stability without a lot of investments and Perpetual Motion 2x. Buzzard is an incredibly strong sidearm with incredible stats. Definitely give it a try if you like sidearms."
